title: Inverse conversion between layer indices
statement: Let $C$ be a directed acyclic circuit with $n$ input vertices and a list of gates, and let $d$ be a layer index with $d\le$ the number of gates. Identifying the vertices in that layer with the indices $0,\ldots,n+d-1$, converting such an index to a layer vertex and then back to an index returns the original index.
hypotheses_covered: $C$ is a directed acyclic circuit with $n$ input vertices
$d$ is an index among the number of gates plus two layer positions
The value of $d$ is at most the number of gates
$i$ is an index among the $n+d$ vertices
